get.summary: Starts Google sign-in.
Returns the signed-in user and whether they can use the app yet.

post.summary: Revokes the current session and clears the session cookie.

get.summary: Returns the relocation's budget. Estimates, expenses, and prices of items still to buy are compared in the budget currency.

put.summary: Sets up the budget with its currency, or changes the currency while it has no estimates.
Saves the optional monthly net income, or clears it. The budget currency must already exist.

delete.summary: Deletes a budget category and its estimates. Categories with expenses or shopping items are refused.

post.summary: Adds an estimate in the budget currency.

get.summary: Lists calendar events and, separately, task due dates.

post.summary: Adds a milestone or an appointment. A task due date is left unchanged.

put.summary: Updates a milestone or an appointment. A task due date is left unchanged.

delete.summary: Deletes a calendar event. The relocation's tasks stay.

get.summary: Returns the suggested checklist without writing tasks.

post.summary: Confirms the selected checklist tasks for a relocation.

get.summary: Lists city names for a country.
Lists the relocation's documents, oldest first.

post.summary: Stores a private file on this relocation. PDF, JPEG, PNG, and WebP up to 10 MB.

put.summary: Sets the category, expiration date, and tasks. The file is unchanged.

delete.summary: Deletes the document and its stored file.

get.summary: Returns the file when the signed-in user owns the relocation.
Lists the relocation's expenses, newest first, in the currency they were paid in.

post.summary: Records an expense with its original amount and currency.

get.summary: Lists homes the signed-in user is comparing for this relocation.

post.summary: Adds a home to compare. The budget, tasks, and calendar stay unchanged.

put.summary: Updates a home. Choosing it does not copy the rent into the budget.

delete.summary: Deletes a home. The relocation's budget and tasks stay.

get.summary: Lists the relocation's belongings, by room and then by name.

post.summary: Adds a belonging. A bring item with no packing status starts as not packed.

get.summary: Returns a room shopping list without writing items. Items already stored under the same code are left out.

post.summary: Adds the selected list items as things to buy. Items already stored under the same code are skipped.

put.summary: Updates a belonging. Prices stay as entered.

get.summary: Lists job applications the signed-in user is tracking for this relocation.

post.summary: Adds a job application. The next date is not written to the calendar.

put.summary: Updates a job application. The calendar stays unchanged.

delete.summary: Deletes a job application. The relocation's calendar stays.

get.summary: Lists the signed-in user's in-app reminders, unread first.

post.summary: Marks one in-app reminder as read. A second call keeps the first time.
Marks every in-app reminder as read.

get.summary: Returns how the signed-in user wants to be reminded. The default is in the app, 3 days before.

put.summary: Sets the channel and how many days before a date to remind the signed-in user.

get.summary: Downloads the relocation as a PDF. The file is not stored.
Downloads the summary as a PDF. The file is not stored.
Lists the signed-in user's relocations.

post.summary: Creates a relocation for the signed-in user.

get.summary: Returns one relocation owned by the signed-in user.

put.summary: Updates a relocation owned by the signed-in user.

delete.summary: Deletes a relocation owned by the signed-in user.

get.summary: Lists the signed-in user's tasks for a relocation, with progress.

post.summary: Adds a task to the signed-in user's relocation.

delete.summary: Deletes a task owned by the signed-in user.

put.summary: Updates a task owned by the signed-in user.

post.summary: Swaps this task with the one before it. The first task has no earlier move.
Swaps this task with the one after it. The last task has no later move.

get.summary: Returns the service name.
